name: FASTNET Ancona Data Center / Service Farm
notes: Operator page describes a Tier 4-compliant Fastnet data center in Ancona providing cloud server and colocation services; Data Center Map lists the facility as Fastnet Service Farm in Ancona.

name: EXA Ancona Data Center
notes: Directory sources place EXA Ancona in Chiaravalle, Ancona, Marche; Inflect reports 10,000 kW total power. Treated as operational colocation/edge infrastructure, but capacity should be confirmed with the operator.

name: Digital Realty ROM1 Rome
notes: Digital Realty announced groundbreaking for ROM1 in Rome, with completion targeted for 2027; trade coverage reports 3 MW IT capacity at launch.

name: Aruba Hyper Cloud Data Center IT4 Rome
notes: Aruba's Rome IT4 campus in Tecnopolo Tiburtino is described by the operator as 74,000 sqm with five 6 MW data center buildings for 30 MW achievable IT power; first building active at inauguration.

name: UniCenter Rome
developer: UniCenter S.p.A. / Unidata / Azimut Libera Impresa
notes: Unidata/Azimut JV project for a green carrier-neutral Tier IV-quality Rome data center; DCD and Unidata investor material report approximately 20 MW and more than 2,000 racks.

name: Mediterra ROM01 Rome
notes: Mediterra lists ROM01, formerly Cloud Europe, in Rome's Tecnopolo Tiburtino; DCD reported Mediterra operates the former Cloud Europe 4 MW, 6,000 sqm Rome site.

name: Retelit Roma Cornelia Data Center
notes: Retelit states it operates a national data-center network; directory sources identify the Rome Cornelia facility, with OCOLO reporting 0.30 MW.

name: Open Fiber Edge Data Center Pescara
notes: Open Fiber announced/inaugurated an Edge Data Center in San Giovanni Teatino, just outside Pescara, supporting low-latency services such as AI, IoT, and 5G.

name: EXA Alba Adriatica Data Center
notes: Inflect lists EXA Alba Adriatica at Via Adriatica 74 in Alba Adriatica, Teramo/Abruzzo as an operational colocation/connectivity facility.

name: Regione Abruzzo Data Center
notes: Regional-government data center page confirms a public-sector data center function for Regione Abruzzo; included for coverage of non-commercial/government infrastructure.

name: EXA Termoli Data Center
notes: Directory sources list EXA Infrastructure's Termoli facility at Via Polonia 73, Termoli, Campobasso, Molise. No primary operator spec page found during this pass.

name: DATAforMED Caserta Campus
notes: DATAforMED's site describes a 30 MW/60,000 sqm campus coming soon; DBA Group project story reports 22.5 MW IT power capacity across several buildings in Caserta. Capacity recorded as IT-power figure from DBA.

name: Convergenze Innovation Center Data Center
notes: Operator housing page says the data center is located at Convergenze Innovation Center, Via Seliano 2, Capaccio Paestum; DCHub reports 3.0 MW operational power capacity.

name: Telecom Italia Sparkle Naples Data Center
notes: Inflect lists Telecom Italia Sparkle Telecom Italia Naples at Piazza Giuseppe Garibaldi 60, Naples. Treated as an operational carrier/colocation node with limited public specifications.

name: Adriatic DC Bari Data Center / Puglia Data Center Valley
notes: Adriatic DC's site identifies a portfolio of AI factory campuses in Apulia; company-distributed release says the former Manifattura Tabacchi site in Bari is planned as a 200 MW data center. DCD notes claims are early and few details were shared.

name: Adriatic DC Brindisi Greenfield Facility
notes: Adriatic DC release and trade coverage describe a second greenfield facility in Brindisi's industrial area, planned at 500 MW. Marked planned because first construction sites were scheduled for late 2026.

name: Adriatic DC Hub Apulia Campus
notes: Company-distributed release describes a 1.5 GW, roughly 2,000-acre greenfield campus under the Puglia Data Center Valley program; DCD cautions that public details remain limited.

name: BINAP Bari Edge Data Center
notes: BINAP operator site describes a next-generation edge data center in Bari offering colocation, cloud, backup, and interconnection services.

name: LEIX - Levante Internet Exchange / Arpitel Bari Data Center
notes: Data Center Map lists LEIX, Arpitel's Bari Data Center and Internet Exchange, as a Bari colocation/cloud/connectivity hub. Primary operator page not found during this pass.

name: Regione Basilicata Data Center Unico Regionale
notes: Regione Basilicata describes its regional data center as a core digital-agenda infrastructure hosting hundreds of subregional public bodies on RUPAR.

name: Regione Calabria Cittadella Regionale Data Center
notes: Regione Calabria department page identifies coordination, maintenance, evolution, and disaster-recovery work for the regional data center; ACN lists the Cittadella Regionale data center.

name: Regione Calabria Data Center Expansion Program
notes: Regional act references 'Espansione infrastruttura data center regionale' with EUR 9.75 million, plus related platform-extension funding. Public-sector infrastructure expansion, not commercial colocation.

name: Keliweb DC2 Rende/Cosenza
notes: Directory sources list Keliweb DC2 in Rende/Cosenza as an operational data center with ISO27001 noted by Data Center Map; no primary operator spec page found during this pass.

name: TLCWEB Data Center Lamezia Terme
notes: Operator page describes the TLCWEB data center with environmental sensors, cooling, access controls, video surveillance, separated power lines, UPS, generator, and rack cabinets.

name: Sparkle Sicily Hub Palermo
notes: Sparkle official page describes Sicily Hub as an open data center in Palermo and Mediterranean IP gravity center connected to Sicily cable landing stations; Baxtel market page reports 2 MW for Palermo/Sicily facilities.

name: Mediterra PMO01 / Open Hub Med Palermo
notes: Mediterra lists PMO01 as the former Open Hub Med Palermo data center; DCD reports Open Hub Med operates a 2 MW, 1,000 sqm facility in Carini near Palermo and was acquired by Mediterra.

name: Open Hub Med Carini Neutral Hub
notes: Italtel announced the Sicily-based neutral hub for exchange of internet traffic between Europe and the Mediterranean; DCD later covered the launch on an existing Italtel data-center campus. Included separately from the newer Mediterra branding for historical project lineage.

name: Tiscali / Tessellis Sa Illetta Data Centre Cagliari
notes: Tessellis official page describes the Sa Illetta Data Centre in Cagliari as a national telecommunications exchange point and Sardinia connectivity hub; directories identify Tiscali Cagliari as an operational data center.

name: Energy Vault Digital Vault Sulcis AI Data Center
notes: Regional and press sources describe Digital Vault Sulcis as part of a plan to transform the former Nuraxi Figus mine/Sulcis area into data-center and energy infrastructure; Unione Sarda reports national strategic approval and EUR 1.5 billion investment.

name: Data Center Gallura Olbia
notes: Data Center Map lists Data Center Gallura in Olbia as a digital infrastructure hub with ACN level AI2 certification. Primary operator evidence not found during this pass.

name: Digital Metalla / Dauvea Sardinian Mine Data Center
notes: Trade coverage described Dauvea/Digital Metalla plan for an underground data center in a disused/Roman mine on Sant'Antioco, Sardinia. Current status unclear, so retained as planned with older evidence.
